sources.title: Meme-Qwen-7B-Instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Meme-Qwen-7B-Instruct is a LoRA adapter applied to the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base model. The architecture inherits from Qwen2.5, which uses a transformer decoder-only design with improvements in instruction following, long-context handling (8K+ tokens), structured data understanding, and JSON output generation compared to Qwen2.
